sourceSummary: Generate a set of distinct, testable ad-copy variations for one offer across the angles worth A/B testing: it first locks the platform and its constraints (headline/description character limits), the offer, audience, and the distinct messaging angles to test (benefit, pain, social proof, urgency, curiosity), then drafts multiple complete variants per angle so each is a genuine test of a hypothesis rather than a trivial reword.
